source.title: Published FlyBody flight-imitation controller
source.license_note: The Figshare policy dataset is GPL 3.0+; the separate FlyBody source repository is Apache-2.0.

input.preprocessing: C-order flatten each observation field and concatenate; no input normalization or clipping.

output.note: The upstream TestPolicyWrapper uses the mean. CanonicalSpecWrapper clips/rescales separately; the unused variance head is omitted.

scope: A released trained joint-actuation policy. This does not map BANC motor neurons to muscles and does not establish takeoff, landing, or feeding.

validation.method: NumPy forward pass compared to unmodified published SavedModel distribution mean
validation.type_spec_compatibility: Legacy TFP class-name registry aliases only; no graph or weight changes
